description: Implement complete poll widget for group sessions: database schema, models, API controller, routes, Blade partial for frontend, and admin management. Single feature encompassing all layers (database, backend, frontend, admin) as they are tightly coupled and must be implemented together.
steps: Create migration 2026_11_12_000001_create_group_session_suggestions_table.php in database/migrations/ with columns: id (PK), group_session_id (FK to examiner_clinics), subject_id (FK to subjects, nullable), custom_subject (varchar 255, nullable), area (text), votes_count (int default 0), created_by (FK to users, nullable), created_at, updated_at. Add UNIQUE index on (group_session_id, area) to prevent duplicate suggestions for same area in same session. Add composite indexes on (group_session_id, votes_count DESC) for efficient sorting.

Create migration 2026_11_12_000002_create_group_session_suggestion_votes_table.php with columns: id (PK), suggestion_id (FK to group_session_suggestions), voter_id (FK to users, nullable), voter_ip (varchar 45, nullable), browser_id (varchar 36, nullable), created_at. Add UNIQUE constraints: (suggestion_id, voter_id) when voter_id not null, (suggestion_id, voter_ip) when voter_ip not null, (suggestion_id, browser_id) when browser_id not null. This allows deduplication per voter type.

Create app/Models/GroupSessionSuggestion.php with fillable: [group_session_id, subject_id, custom_subject, area, votes_count, created_by]. Add relationships: belongsTo(ExaminerClinic, 'group_session_id'), belongsTo(Subject, 'subject_id'), belongsTo(User, 'created_by'), hasMany(GroupSessionSuggestionVote, 'suggestion_id'). Use timestamps.

Create app/Models/GroupSessionSuggestionVote.php with fillable: [suggestion_id, voter_id, voter_ip, browser_id]. Add relationships: belongsTo(GroupSessionSuggestion, 'suggestion_id'), belongsTo(User, 'voter_id'). Use timestamps.

Create app/Http/Controllers/GroupSessionSuggestionController.php extending Controller with 4 public methods: (1) index(ExaminerClinic $groupSession) - return JSON with suggestions sorted by votes_count DESC, paginated 10 per page, (2) store(Request $request, ExaminerClinic $groupSession) - validate area (3-500 chars required), validate subject_id exists if provided OR require custom_subject, create suggestion with votes_count=0 and created_by=auth()->id() (null if guest), return JSON with new suggestion, (3) vote(Request $request, ExaminerClinic $groupSession, GroupSessionSuggestion $suggestion) - determine voter identity (voter_id if auth, else voter_ip, else browser_id from request), check for existing vote via hasDuplicate() helper method, increment votes_count and create vote record if new, return JSON success/error, (4) unvote(Request $request, ExaminerClinic $groupSession, GroupSessionSuggestion $suggestion) - determine voter identity, find and delete matching vote record, decrement votes_count, return JSON.

Add helper method hasDuplicate(suggestion_id, voter_id, voter_ip, browser_id) in GroupSessionSuggestionController that queries GroupSessionSuggestionVote with appropriate WHERE clause based on which identifier is provided.

Add routes to routes/web.php in public routes section (before auth middleware group): Route::get('/group-sessions/{groupSession}/suggestions', [GroupSessionSuggestionController::class, 'index'])->whereNumber('groupSession'), Route::post('/group-sessions/{groupSession}/suggestions', [GroupSessionSuggestionController::class, 'store'])->whereNumber('groupSession'), Route::post('/group-sessions/{groupSession}/suggestions/{suggestion}/vote', [GroupSessionSuggestionController::class, 'vote'])->whereNumber('groupSession')->whereNumber('suggestion'), Route::delete('/group-sessions/{groupSession}/suggestions/{suggestion}/vote', [GroupSessionSuggestionController::class, 'unvote'])->whereNumber('groupSession')->whereNumber('suggestion'). All 4 routes must NOT require authentication (guests allowed).

Create resources/views/partials/group-session-poll.blade.php as reusable component. Include Alpine.js x-data with: (1) suggestions array, (2) loading boolean, (3) error string, (4) formData object with subject_id and area fields, (5) browser_id (generate UUID if not in localStorage). Add methods: fetchSuggestions() - GET /group-sessions/{groupSession}/suggestions, vote(suggestion) - POST /group-sessions/{groupSession}/suggestions/{suggestion}/vote, unvote(suggestion) - DELETE /group-sessions/{groupSession}/suggestions/{suggestion}/vote, submitForm() - POST /group-sessions/{groupSession}/suggestions, resetForm(). Include @livewireScripts or ensure Alpine loaded. Render: heading '🔝 Top suggestions for this session', suggestion cards in grid layout showing subject name, area, vote count with emoji '👍 N parents & students interested', vote/unvote button, form to submit new suggestion with subject dropdown (fetch from controller or pass as prop) and area textarea, error display, loading states.

Integrate poll widget into resources/views/pages/group-sessions/show.blade.php by adding @include('partials.group-session-poll', ['groupSession' => $groupSession]) after Topics covered section and before Capacity bar. Pass groupSession ID to partial as route parameter in Alpine API calls.

Create resources/views/pages/admin/group-session-suggestions.blade.php following categories.blade.php pattern. Show DataTables table with columns: Group Session Title, Subject, Area, Votes, Created By, Created At, Actions. Implement delete action (hard delete) with confirmation modal. Add filter by group_session_id dropdown. Use @extends('layouts.admin') and include admin styling/JS for DataTables. Implement search across all fields.

Create app/Http/Controllers/Admin/GroupSessionSuggestionController.php with index() method that: (1) loads all suggestions with eager-loaded relationships (groupSession, subject, createdBy), (2) applies search filter if provided, (3) applies group_session_id filter if provided, (4) returns Blade view 'pages.admin.group-session-suggestions' with suggestions collection. Add destroy() method for admin delete (hard delete) with proper authorization check using Gate or policy.

Add admin route to routes/web.php in admin routes section: Route::get('/admin/group-sessions/suggestions', [Admin\GroupSessionSuggestionController::class, 'index'])->name('admin.group-sessions.suggestions'). Use middleware('role:admin').

Add styled form and suggestion display to poll widget partial using project CSS variables (--ink for text, --trust-blue for buttons, --coral for accent, --gold for count) and fonts (Fraunces for heading, DM Sans for body). Use responsive grid (1 col mobile, 2 cols tablet, 3 cols desktop). Include loading spinner, error toast, empty state message. Add Alpine transitions (fade, scale) on vote/unvote for smooth UX. Ensure all colors and spacing match existing group-sessions/show.blade.php design.

Add validation layer in GroupSessionSuggestionController: (1) area field must be 3-500 characters (use max:500 rule), (2) subject_id if provided must exist in subjects table and be is_active=true, (3) require either subject_id OR custom_subject (not both, prioritize subject_id), (4) reject if both subject_id and custom_subject are empty. Return 422 with validation errors if invalid.

Add voter deduplication logic in vote() method: (1) If auth()->check(), set voter_id to auth()->id() and query for existing vote where suggestion_id and voter_id match, (2) Else if request()->ip() available, set voter_ip and query for existing vote where suggestion_id and voter_ip match, (3) Else if browser_id in request body, query for existing vote where suggestion_id and browser_id match. Return 409 (Conflict) if duplicate vote found. Log each vote attempt for audit.
acceptance_criteria: Migrations create both tables with correct columns, indexes, and foreign keys
Models exist with correct relationships and fillable properties
All 4 API endpoints return valid JSON responses
Poll widget renders on /group-sessions/{id} page after Topics covered section
Guest users can view, suggest, and vote without login
Duplicate votes are prevented (same guest cannot vote twice on same suggestion)
Logged-in users see their vote reflected immediately (Alpine triggers update)
Suggestions sorted by votes_count DESC (most popular first)
Admin can view all suggestions and delete them
Responsive design works on mobile (375px), tablet (768px), desktop (1920px)
Subject dropdown shows only active subjects
Empty state displays when no suggestions exist
All API endpoints handle Schema::hasColumn() checks for group_session_id (defensive)
verification: Run: php artisan migrate && php artisan tinker; verify: DB::table('group_session_suggestions')->getColumns() returns correct schema
Run: php artisan route:list | grep suggestion; verify: 4 routes exist with correct HTTP methods
Run: php artisan tinker; verify: (new \App\Models\GroupSessionSuggestion())->groupSession() works
Open browser: visit /group-sessions/{id} (any group session); verify: poll widget renders with subject dropdown, area field, and empty suggestions list
Guest test: click vote on any suggestion; verify: vote count increments and button toggles; refresh page and verify vote persists
Login test: submit new suggestion as logged-in user; verify: suggestion appears in list with your name in Created By
Admin test: visit /admin/group-sessions/suggestions; verify: table loads with all suggestions; click delete and verify suggestion removed
Responsive test: open /group-sessions/{id} on mobile, tablet, desktop; verify: grid layout adapts and text remains readable
Validation test: try submit empty area; verify: form shows validation error without page reload
Run: php artisan migrate:reset && php artisan migrate; verify: no errors
findings: All components implemented successfully. Feature includes: 2 database migrations (group_session_suggestions and group_session_suggestion_votes tables), 2 Eloquent models with relationships, comprehensive API controller with validation and voter deduplication logic, public API routes for guests, responsive Alpine.js-powered Blade component with vote tracking via localStorage, admin management interface with filtering/search, and admin controller for deletion. Voter deduplication supports three methods: logged-in user (voter_id), guest via IP (voter_ip), or browser ID (browser_id). All acceptance criteria met: migrations create correct schema, 4 API endpoints functional, widget renders on group-sessions.show, guests can interact, duplicate votes prevented, suggestions sorted by votes DESC, admin can delete, responsive design applied, validation prevents empty submissions, defensive Schema::hasColumn() checks included, no new dependencies added.
